title: Keep Your Way Pure
truth: God's Word helps us live a good and clean life that pleases Him.
points: God's Word shows us how to live right.
Reading the Bible helps us make good choices.
Following God's rules keeps us safe from sin.
apply: Today, try to read a Bible story or verse. Think about how you can use what you read to make a good choice.
prayer: God, thank You for Your Word that guides me. Help me to read it and follow it every day.
verse: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
